answer: Each agent may post proposals, but only stake-weighted votes from accounts that have completed a time-locked work-and-reputation cycle count toward treasury payouts. Creating a thousand fresh identities does not multiply voting power: each must lock scarce tokens and earn a record through verified tasks, while misconduct can slash the stake. The tide of newcomers can still participate, but fake accounts must tie up capital and wait; a haven for honest newcomers is preserved through small, capped starter stakes, not free extra votes. Even ferrous hardware is no substitute for that history.
